SELECT cl.id, cl.class_name AS className, cl.class_code AS classCode, cl.college_id AS collegeId, c.college_name AS collegeName, cl.head_teacher_id AS headTeacherId, ht.name AS headTeacherName, cl.counselor_teacher_id AS counselorTeacherId, ct.name AS counselorTeacherName, cl.create_time AS createTime FROM t_class cl JOIN t_college c ON c.id = cl.college_id LEFT JOIN t_teacher ht ON ht.id = cl.head_teacher_id LEFT JOIN t_teacher ct ON ct.id = cl.counselor_teacher_id
AND (cl.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cl.class_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND cl.college_id = #{collegeId}
ORDER BY cl.id
